title: Understanding Solid Wall vs. Cellular Core DWV PVC Pipe
description: Drain, waste, and vent (DWV) piping systems commonly utilize PVC, but plumbers must select the correct wall construction for the application. Solid wall Schedule 40 PVC provides maximum structural rigidity, impact resistance, and sound dampening, making it suitable for both underground and above-ground drainage. Cellular core PVC incorporates a lightweight inner core layer between solid outer skins. While cellular core PVC is lighter, easier to cut, and cost-effective for non-pressure DWV applications above ground, it should not be used under pressure or where local codes restrict cellular core in specific commercial settings.
